name: Compose Auto Shimmer
tagline: Stop hand-coding skeleton screens. Your UI is your skeleton.
description: An open-source Jetpack Compose library that automatically transforms live UI component trees into responsive, pixel-matched shimmer loading skeletons without hand-coded placeholder layouts.
verifiedDetails: Provides three flexible integration modes: ShimmerBox (automatic wrapper measured from live layouts), ShimmerOverlay (sweep effect over arbitrary elements), and ShimmerPlaceholder (fixed dimensions).
Eliminates skeleton-to-layout drift across foldables, tablets, and varying Android device form factors.
Published and installable via JitPack for Compose 1.4+.

name: Android Crash-Fix Assistant
tagline: Autonomous Ticket-to-PR Android Crash Debugger and Code Repair Pipeline
description: A multi-agent software engineering system built with CrewAI that autonomously ingests Android crash stack traces, plans architectural repairs, modifies codebase via Antigravity CLI, runs compilation tests, and verifies fixes on live Android devices via ADB before opening pull requests.
verifiedDetails: Architected 7 specialized agents: Crash Analyst, Prompt Engineer, Antigravity Operator, Build Verifier, Device Operator, Git Release Manager, and PR Report Compiler.
Integrates custom bridge tools enforcing directory sandboxing, command sanitization, and lifecycle safety constraints.
Automates physical verification: launches activities on connected emulators/devices via ADB and captures screenshot receipts to validate fix stability.

name: CricScore: Live Match Scorer
tagline: Track live cricket matches, scorecards, stats, and tournament scores offline.
description: A production-grade Android sports application designed for real-time offline scoring, individual player statistics tracking, and tournament management with clean, reactive Jetpack Compose interfaces.
verifiedDetails: Engineered from architectural design through Google Play Store production release.
Implements modern Android architecture patterns with Jetpack Compose, MVVM state holding, and robust local offline persistence via Room DB.
Optimized for smooth UI rendering and strict state preservation across configuration changes.

name: AutoLocale
tagline: Stop writing strings.xml by hand. Your code is your source of truth.
description: A dual-module Android developer tooling suite consisting of a Gradle plugin that statically scans Kotlin Jetpack Compose code for hardcoded strings and generates localized strings.xml files across languages, alongside a Compose-native runtime for dynamic locale switching.
verifiedDetails: Architected autolocale-plugin featuring AST SourceTransformer, Collision-safe KeyGenerator, and XmlManager.
Architected autolocale-runtime providing AutoLocaleManager, AutoLocaleProvider, and reactive AutoLocaleState for instant in-app language toggling.
Eliminates human error, missing resource keys, and code-to-resource drift in multi-language Android apps.

name: VU Learning Assistant
tagline: Autonomous LMS Quiz-Tracking & Assessment Workflow Assistant
description: A hybrid automation system combining a LangGraph state machine with headless Playwright browser automation to sign into student portals, track active quiz deadlines across courses, and dispatch automated email summaries via Resend.

verifiedDetails: Scheduled daily morning search evaluating incoming Android roles against skills, compensation, and location parameters.
Integrates LLM scoring nodes that generate structured candidate match ratings and draft custom outreach briefs.
Automates record archiving in Google Sheets with instant Gmail notification dispatches.
